SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-14-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-14-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF JOSE ANSELMO APPEARED. DEFENDANT GEICO INSURANCE APPEARED, REPRESENTED BY TERRY LEHMAN, AUTO DAMAGE ADJUSTER. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE OF CLAIM. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD MITCHELL, CLERK: A. MOK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-14-2017 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ANSELMO, JOSE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GEICO INSURANCE $1,200.00 PRINCIPAL, $45.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,245.00, IN LIEU OF PAYMENT AND AT THE ELECTION OF DEFENDANT, DEFENDANT MAY, NOT LATER THAN SEPTEMBER 8, 2017, AND WITH PLAINTIFF'S COOPERATION, MAKE THE REPAIRS TO THE CENTER CONSOLE OF PLAINTIFF'S GEICO INSURED VEHICLE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,500.00 FILED BY ANSELMO, JOSE AS TO DEFENDANT GEICO INSURANCE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-14-2017 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
